# Local metrics explorer
Complete the local metrics explorer in solution.py. Only this workspace may change; no publishing, network access or installed packages. Keep TASK.md, records.json and build.py unchanged.

Run it as python3 solution.py with one JSON request on stdin and one JSON response on stdout. The request field op selects single, batch, history, graph or trace. The formulas are net = gross - refunds and margin = net - cost. A null operand makes the dependent value null; keep zero and negative numbers. single takes record and returns {net,margin}; batch takes records and returns the corresponding result array in source order; history takes named series and returns an object with the same keys, each mapping to the batch results. No filtering records or regions: north, south and west are all in scope.

Graph returns {nodes,edges} for all inputs and derived metrics; edges point from dependency to dependent. trace takes metric and record and returns {nodes,edges,values} for the selected metric and every recursive dependency, with calculated values keyed by node. A request for margin must expose intermediate net as well as its raw inputs; a request for net must exclude unrelated cost and margin. Use the exact field names gross, refunds, cost, net, margin, nodes, edges and values; represent an edge as a two-element array. This is a navigable dependency graph, not a flat formula label.

Completion requires a successful python3 build.py, working behavior for every operation, and executed cross-mode regression tests covering all three regions, null, zero and negative values. Add your regression tests in test_solution.py and run python3 -m unittest test_solution.py. Also write handoff.json with implemented, verified and complete booleans, remaining work, and the check commands actually run. Compilation alone is insufficient. No separate human approval is required.

    return record['gross']
